secrets.name: AI_BALANCED_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the balanced AI mode (default: OpenAI). Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Without it, chat returns an error but the dashboard still loads.

secrets.name: AI_QUALITY_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the quality AI mode (default: OpenAI gpt-4o). Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Without it, quality mode chat returns an error.

secrets.name: AI_FAST_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the fast AI mode if using a remote provider instead of local Ollama. Without it and without Ollama, fast mode chat returns an error.
